mentions.name: Marginalia Search
mentions.description: An independent web search engine. Recent work optimizes the index so ranking calculations are almost entirely CPU-bound; since queries run on a timeout, faster ranking yields better results. Other work improves search result relevance by fixing jank, and adds commercial features such as query monitoring (e.g. for backlinks or brand mentions) with email alerts when new results appear.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Marginalia Search as usual.

Recently went on an optimization bender that saw the index now become almost completely bottle-necked by CPU in the ranking calculations step.  Pretty neat.  Faster ranking means better results as queries run on a timeout.

Also working on making the search results more relevant by fixing jank.

Also working on some more commercial features, like the ability to monitor queries (e.g. for backlinks or brand mentions) and get an email when there are new results.
